.. change::
    :tags: feature, api
    :tickets: 1872

    Added the ``alembic.dialects`` entry point group, which allows third party
    dialects to register a :class:`.DefaultImpl` subclass for their dialect
    without requiring it to be eagerly loaded.

    When a :class:`.DefaultImpl` subclass declares a ``__dialect__`` that is
    already registered and it is not a subclass of the existing
    implementation, a warning is now presented.  The new
    :meth:`.RegisterImpl.resolve_registration_conflict` hook is used to resolve
    conflicts; by default, the latest registered subclass wins, emulating
    the existing behavior.

    An unknown dialect name now raises :class:`.NoSuchDialectError`, which
    is a subclass of :class:`.CommandError`.  Registration now uses a
    ``RegisterImpl`` base class, and the ``ImplMeta`` metaclass has been
    removed.  Pull request courtesy Daniel Reeves.

    .. seealso::

        :ref:`alembic.ddl.third_party`
